style: Art style: hand-painted stylized dark-fantasy game art for a mobile RPG. Painterly digital illustration with visible, confident brush strokes and simplified planar shapes, crisp rim light on edges, strong readable silhouettes, deep near-black shadows. Light tells the story: a few strong sources — crystals and cracks that glow from within — throw colored light upward, the light comes from below. Cold and warm light contrast. Dust motes and grains of sand float in the light. Moderate detail, clean readable forms. No photorealism, no 3D-render look, no anime. Match the brushwork, lighting and color handling of the attached style reference images, but do NOT copy their subjects, objects, letters or composition.
negative: No text, no letters, no numbers, no captions, titles or labels under, over or inside the icons, no real-world alphabets, no runes or marks that look like writing, no watermark, no signature, no logo, no UI elements, no frames or borders drawn inside the cells. No pentagrams, no occult signs. No magenta or pink anywhere inside the icons: magenta appears only in the gutters.

spell-icons.frame: Format: a sheet of square ability icons for a mobile RPG, painted together as one consistent set. The icons stand in a precise grid of equal square cells; the number of columns and rows and the picture in every cell are listed below, row by row from the top, each row from left to right. Between the cells run narrow straight gutters of flat, uniform pure magenta (#FF00FF), and the same magenta gutter runs around the outside of the whole grid. All gutters have the same width, all cells have the same size, and nothing crosses a gutter. Every cell is its own complete square painting filled from edge to edge — the game puts its own frame on top: one clear central image with a bold silhouette that stays readable at 48 px, on a dark near-black stone background with faint cracks and a darker vignette toward the edges of the cell. Light rises from below in the color of the magic school; crisp rim light on the edges of the forms; a few sparks and dust motes in the light. All icons share the same brushwork, lighting, level of detail and palette, so they read as one set, and each icon differs clearly from its neighbours in shape and composition.

jobs.title: Без школы — 24 активки сеткой 6×4
jobs.subject:
This sheet has no magic school: these are the fighting skills of plain warriors, with no magic at all — steel, iron, worn leather, rope, wood, white linen bandages and dark red blood; the light from below is the warm orange light of torches and campfires. Attacking skills are brutal and heavy — steel in motion. Supporting skills — healing, bandaging, shields and battle spirit for allies — glow a softer warm gold of torchlight with rounded, calm shapes. No glowing magic and no magic crystals anywhere. A spell for all targets shows something wide that fills its cell; a spell for two or three targets shows two or three of its thing; a spell for one target shows one focused object. Attacks move to the right, toward the enemies. Every icon, even the widest, is built around one clear central object with a bold silhouette — never only smoke, dust, snow, fog or a scattered pattern.

The grid: exactly 6 columns and 4 rows, 24 icons.

Row 1: a huge two-handed greatsword swinging in a wide horizontal arc to the right across the whole cell, a blur of motion behind it; three throwing axes spinning through the air to the right; one heavy spear thrusting to the right, its point punching through a dented iron plate; a traveller's heavy backpack, bedroll and waterskin laid down against a stone, warm lantern light spreading wide across the whole cell; three surgical tools laid out on an open leather roll — a curved needle, small pliers and a small knife — in warm light; one battered leather waterskin with a wooden stopper, in warm light.

Row 2: a shield wall — a wide row of overlapping round wooden shields with iron rims filling the whole width of the cell; three tall rectangular wooden shields planted in the ground side by side; one heavy iron tower shield, dented and scratched, standing upright; a leather bandolier of throwing knives in the center, a volley of knives flying out of it to the right in a wide fan across the whole cell; three serrated hunting knives with blood on their teeth; one slim blade with a groove down its middle, a thin stream of dark red blood running down it and dripping.

Row 3: a big roll of white linen bandage in the center, unrolling in long, wide ribbons across the whole cell; three leather tourniquet straps with wooden twist-sticks, laid side by side; one forearm wrapped in a clean white bandage, tied off with a neat knot; a huge spiked iron flail ball slamming into the ground, a ring of dust and stones spreading across the whole cell; a wooden quarterstaff sweeping low and knocking two boots off the ground; one iron helmet with a deep fresh dent, a spark at the point of impact.

Row 4: a massive battering ram with an iron head smashing into a wall of shields, the shields scattering across the whole cell; two armoured boots with their leather straps slashed through, a thin red cut above each heel; one round wooden shield split in half, its planks broken apart; a tall war banner of plain cloth raised high on a pole, streaming proudly, warm torchlight spreading widely; two war drums with crossed drumsticks, in warm light; one burning torch raised high, its warm flame bright.

This sheet has no magic school: these are the fighting skills of plain warriors, with no magic at all — steel, iron, worn leather, rope, wood, white linen bandages and dark red blood; the light from below is the warm orange light of torches and campfires. Attacking skills are brutal and heavy — steel in motion. Supporting skills — healing, bandaging, shields and battle spirit for allies — glow a softer warm gold of torchlight with rounded, calm shapes. No glowing magic and no magic crystals anywhere. Every icon, even the widest, is built around one clear central object with a bold silhouette — never only smoke, dust, snow, fog or a scattered pattern.

The grid: exactly 4 columns and 4 rows, 16 icons. Rows 1 and 2 are ultimate spells — the grandest, most epic images of the set, bigger in scale, with bright gold highlights in the torchlight. Row 3 are passive traits — calm, emblem-like single objects, no action. Row 4 are reactions — an instant answer to an event in battle, shown as one moment of action.

Row 1: a massive executioner's axe crashing down onto one single point, the ground splitting, sparks flying; a big field hospital tent glowing warmly from inside, white linen hanging, stretchers and bandages in front of it; a lone warrior's great shield planted in the ground before a ruined gate, arrows breaking against it, torchlight and gold; a battlefield soaked in blood, dozens of swords and spears stuck in the ground, red mist over it.

Row 2: a large wooden medicine chest standing open, full of rolls of bandages, small bottles and tools, warm golden light; a gigantic war hammer slamming down, a shockwave cracking the ground in a wide ring, dust and stones flying; a broken shield wall — shattered shields, snapped spears and a fallen banner scattered across the ground; a great crowd of raised spears and banners of plain cloth under a golden sky, torches blazing.

Row 3: a wooden training dummy with a deep sword cut across its chest; one long, narrow, square-headed arrowhead made for piercing armour; a heavy butcher's cleaver stuck in a wooden block; a sword blade plunged into a barrel of water, a burst of steam rising.

Row 4: a sword parrying an enemy blade and striking back in the same motion, sparks flying; a bloodied fist clenching tight around a notched sword hilt, blood dripping; a shield raised just in time as an arrow strikes it; a sword flipping through the air and caught by its hilt, in warm light.
